wallPerformance.conditions: Same actual room, camera and2mm boundary positions,110ms camera simulation intervals presented on native RAF, 30 warmup +180 measured frames. CPU is camera/update/render submission for this focused fixture. Windows Chrome/native GPU. Camera and physics held deterministic; no shader or quality changes.

limits: Desktop Chrome and Windows WebKit are not a physical iPhone test.
The automatic suite includes an intentionally injected first-second stall to verify detection; its FPS is not a performance comparison.
GPU timing is optional; absent timing is explained, not invented. Memory is an estimate of known resources, not actual VRAM.
The observed cutaway boundary is fixed. This does not establish that every visual flicker has been identified.
Focused wall timing: frame P95 stayed19.3ms; CPU submission mean7.27->7.97ms. Visible draw totals differed505->550, so this is not a strict equal-workload performance comparison or a speedup claim.
Physical iPhone enemy-approach FPS remains unresolved; no graphics, resolution, geometry or enemy-count reductions in this release.
